exclusion.quote_en: This is a dependency order, not a deadline or assignment. Independent subjects may be confirmed in parallel.
exclusion.section_context: 8. Architecture Decision Register > Consistency and Open Questions > Confirmation Order Implied by Dependencies

exclusion.quote_en: 1. **Establish approved authority and deployment boundaries:** provider/residency/key/retention choices and identity/role/service grants (`AD-001–022`). These constrain external routing, source access, tooling, and destructive operations.
exclusion.section_context: 8. Architecture Decision Register > Consistency and Open Questions > Confirmation Order Implied by Dependencies

exclusion.quote_en: 2. **Define formal contracts and identities:** IDL, physical relationships, revision/idempotency, transaction/RLS, hashes, versions, and attribution (`AD-023–032/038/044/068/069/108/109`).
exclusion.section_context: 8. Architecture Decision Register > Consistency and Open Questions > Confirmation Order Implied by Dependencies

exclusion.quote_en: 3. **Confirm business calculations and lifecycle guards:** classification, priority/calendar, quality/retrieval, policy, review, publication, and exit/hold scope (`AD-033–067/077–083`). Do not implement approval or purge mechanics before their binding and race contracts.
exclusion.section_context: 8. Architecture Decision Register > Consistency and Open Questions > Confirmation Order Implied by Dependencies

exclusion.quote_en: 4. **Realize execution and recovery:** worker/scheduler/claim/retry/replay, reconciliation, audit/rotation, release, and recovery mechanics (`AD-070–076/084/087/094–100`) using the confirmed contracts above.
exclusion.section_context: 8. Architecture Decision Register > Consistency and Open Questions > Confirmation Order Implied by Dependencies

exclusion.quote_en: 5. **Bind screens, reporting, and notifications:** approved routes, fields, summaries, source inspection, usage/evaluation presentation, and safe recovery UX (`AD-088–093/101–106/110–114`). Source inspection must be usable before approval; status displays must reflect authoritative completion.
exclusion.section_context: 8. Architecture Decision Register > Consistency and Open Questions > Confirmation Order Implied by Dependencies

exclusion.quote_en: 6. **Finalize executable acceptance evidence:** resolve empty/partial/boundary assertions, statistical calculations, SLO measurement, individual security exit controls, and signed release evidence (`AD-075/091–100/106/107`).
exclusion.section_context: 8. Architecture Decision Register > Consistency and Open Questions > Confirmation Order Implied by Dependencies

exclusion.quote_en: 7. **Record controlled amendments and close narrowly answered items:** preserve original identifiers, cite the confirming Markdown section/requirement or approved amendment, update stale handoff pointers without rewriting specifications in this consolidation, and leave unrelated portions open.
exclusion.section_context: 8. Architecture Decision Register > Consistency and Open Questions > Confirmation Order Implied by Dependencies

exclusion.quote_en: Until that evidence exists, the relevant items remain on hold. Confirmed safety, authorization, durability, truthful-status, and scope restrictions continue to apply throughout.
